akhfash:2-2.t: He said: ﴿كُلٌّ يَجْرِي﴾, meaning "all of it", as you say "كلُّ مُنْطَلِقٌ" (each is going), i.e. all of them.

akhfash:3-3.t: He said: ﴿رَوَاسِيَ﴾; its singular is "راسِيَةٌ" (firm mountain).

akhfash:4-4.t: He said: ﴿يُسْقَىٰ بِمَآءٍ وَاحِدٍ﴾: this feminine refers to "الجَنَّاتِ" (gardens), or, if you wish, to "الأَعْنابِ" (vines), because "الأعْناب" is a group of non-humans and so feminine. However, some read it (يُسْقَى بِماءٍ واحِدٍ), referring it to "الأَعْنابِ", just as He made "الأَنْعام" (cattle) masculine, saying ﴿مِّمَّا فِي بُطُونِهِ﴾, and afterwards made it feminine, saying ﴿وَعَلَيْهَا وَعَلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ تُحْمَلُونَ﴾. So whoever reads (يُسْقَى) with yāʾ makes "الأَعْناب" one of the words treated as feminine and masculine, like "الأَنْعام". [Translator's note: the source quotes the verse with yāʾ (يُسْقَىٰ) although it speaks of "this feminine"; the reading discussed first is «تُسْقَى».]

akhfash:5-5.t: He said: ﴿أَإِذَا كُنَّا تُرَاباً أَإِنَّا لَفِي خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ﴾, and in another place ﴿أَإِذَا كُنَّا تُرَاباً وَآبَآؤُنَآ أَإِنَّا لَمُخْرَجُونَ﴾: the second is what the question falls upon, and the first is a particle**, as you say "أَيَوْمَ الجُمُعَةِ زَيْدٌ مُنْطَلِقٌ" (Is it on Friday that Zayd is leaving?). Whoever makes it a second question makes His words ﴿أَإِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَاباً﴾ an adverb for something mentioned before it, and then makes what is asked about another question; and this is far-fetched. If you wish, you may not make your saying (أَإِذا)*** a question, and put the question in wording on "أَإِنّا", as though you said "يوم الجمعة أعبد الله منطلق" (On Friday — is ʿAbdallāh leaving?), with something implied in it. This is a place where you have begun with "إِذا", and that is not frequent in speech; if you said "اليومَ إِنَّ عَبْدَ اللهِ مُنْطَلِقٌ" (Today, indeed ʿAbdallāh is leaving) it would not be good, though it is permissible. The Arabs have said "مَا عَلِمْتُ إِنَّه لَصالِح" (as far as I know, he is righteous), meaning: "he is righteous, as far as I know".

akhfash:10-10.t:
He said: ﴿مُسْتَخْفٍ بِٱلْلَّيْلِ وَسَارِبٌ بِٱلنَّهَارِ﴾. His words ﴿مُسْتَخْفٍ﴾ he says means "manifest", and "السارِب" means "the one who is hidden". [Translator's note: this is the reverse of the usual gloss (mustakhfin = hidden, sārib = going about openly); translated as written.] It has been read (أَخِفْيها), i.e. "I make it manifest", because you say "خَفَيْتُ السِّرَّ", i.e. I made the secret manifest; and he recited [in the mutaqārib metre, and it is the two hundred and thirty-sixth poetic witness]:
إِنْ تَكْتُموا الداءَ لا نَخْفِهِ * وَإِنْ تَبْعَثُوا الحَرْبَ لاَ نَقْعُدِ
(If you conceal the malady, we shall not reveal it; and if you stir up war, we shall not hold back.)
The ḍamma is better. They claimed that the explanation of (أَكادُ) is "I want", and that it is a dialect, because "أُرِيدُ" (want) may be put in place of "أَكادُ" (I almost), as in (جِداراً يُريدُ اَنْ يَنْقَضَ), i.e. "it was about to collapse"; so likewise "أَكادُ" is only "أُريدُ". The poet said [in the kāmil metre, and it is the two hundred and thirty-seventh poetic witness]:
كَادَتْ وَكِدْتُ وَتِلْكَ خَيْرُ إرادَةٍ * لَوْ عادَ مِنْ لَهْوِ الصبَّابَةِ ما مَضَى
(She wished and I wished — and that is the best of wishes — that the past pleasures of passion might return.)
As for "المُعَقِّباتُ" (the angels that follow one another), it is feminine only because of the frequency of that from them, like "النَّسّابَة" (great genealogist) and "العَلاَّمَة"* (very learned); then He used the masculine because the meaning is masculine, saying (يَحْفَظُونُه مِنْ أَمْرِ اللهِ). [Translator's note: the material on أَخْفِيها and أَكاد concerns Ṭāhā 20:15; it appears here as in the source.]

akhfash:15-15.t: He said: ﴿بِٱلْغُدُوِّ وَٱلآصَالِ﴾ and ﴿بِٱلْعَشِيِّ وَٱلإِبْكَارِ﴾: He made "الغُدُوّ" indicate the morning, though "الغُدُوّ" is an action [a maṣdar]; likewise "الإِبْكار" is from "أَبْكَرَ" "إِبْكاراً". Those who read (الأَبْكار) argued that they had made "بُكْراً" plural as "أَبْكار". But "بُكَرٌ" is not pluralised, because it is a noun that is not fully declinable (ghayr mutamakkin), and it is also a maṣdar like "الإِبكار". As for those who pluralised, they said: "We have only pluralised بُكْرَة and غُدْوَة". But the like of "البُكْرَة" and "الغُدْوَة" is not pluralised thus: "فُعْلَةٌ" does not go with "أَفعال"; "فُعْلَةٌ" goes only with "فُعَل".

akhfash:16-16.t: He said: ﴿أَمْ جَعَلُواْ للَّهِ شُرَكَآءَ﴾: this is the "أَمْ" that is cut off (munqaṭiʿa) from the beginning of the speech.

akhfash:17-17.t:
He said: ﴿فَسَالَتْ أَوْدِيَةٌ بِقَدَرِهَا﴾. You say "أَعْطِني قَدْرَ شِبْرٍ" and "قَدَرَ شِبْرٍ" (give me a span's measure); and you say "قَدَرْتُ" and "أَنَا أَقْدر" "قَدْراً" (I measured). As for the sense of "likeness", it has both "القَدْرُ" and "القَدَر".
And He said ﴿أَوْ مَتَاعٍ زَبَدٌ مِّثْلُهُ﴾; he says: "and of that which they kindle fire over is a foam like it" — saying: "and of that which they kindle fire over is foam like this".

akhfash:23-24.t: He said: ﴿يَدْخُلُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ مِّن كُلِّ بَابٍ سَلاَمٌ عَلَيْكُم﴾, i.e. they say "Peace be upon you".

akhfash:29-29.t: He said: ﴿طُوبَىٰ لَهُمْ وَحُسْنُ مَآبٍ﴾: (طُوبَى) is in the position of the nominative; the nominative of (وَحُسْنُ مآبٍ) shows you that. It is treated like "وَيْلٌ لِزيدٍ" (woe to Zayd), because you may annex it without lām and say "طُوباكَ"; and if you did not annex it, it would be treated like "تَعْساً لِزَيْدٍ" (perdition to Zayd). If you said "لَكَ طُوبى" it would not be good, just as you do not say "لَكَ وَيْلٌ".

akhfash:33-33.t: He said: ﴿أَفَمَنْ هُوَ قَآئِمٌ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ نَفْسٍ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ وَجَعَلُواْ للَّهِ شُرَكَآءَ﴾. This means: "Is He who stands over every soul like their partners?"; it was omitted, and (وَجَعَلُوا للهِ شُرَكَاءَ) came to indicate it.

celaleyn:1-1.t: ﴿المر﴾ Allah knows best what He means by it ﴿تِلْكَ﴾ these verses ﴿آيَاتُ الْكِتَابِ﴾ the Quran; the genitive construct (iḍāfa) is in the sense of مِنْ ("of") ﴿وَالَّذِي أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْكَ مِنْ رَبِّكَ﴾ i.e. the Quran; a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is ﴿الْحَقُّ﴾ in which there is no doubt ﴿وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ﴾ i.e. the people of Mecca ﴿لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ that it is from Him, Exalted is He.

celaleyn:2-2.t: ﴿اللَّهُ الَّذِي رَفَعَ السَّمَاوَاتِ بِغَيْرِ عَمَدٍ تَرَوْنَهَا﴾ i.e. the pillars; plural of عِمَاد, which is a column; and it holds true if there are no pillars at all ﴿ثُمَّ اسْتَوَى عَلَى الْعَرْشِ﴾ a rising that befits Him ﴿وَسَخَّرَ﴾ subjugated ﴿الشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ كُلٌّ﴾ of them ﴿يَجْرِي﴾ in its orbit ﴿لِأَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى﴾ the Day of Resurrection ﴿يُدَبِّرُ الْأَمْرَ﴾ He decrees the affair of His dominion ﴿يُفَصِّلُ﴾ He makes clear ﴿الْآيَاتِ﴾ the signs of His power ﴿لَعَلَّكُمْ﴾ O people of Mecca ﴿بِلِقَاءِ رَبِّكُمْ﴾ through the resurrection ﴿تُوقِنُونَ﴾

celaleyn:3-3.t: ﴿وَهُوَ الَّذِي مَدَّ﴾ spread out ﴿الْأَرْضَ وَجَعَلَ﴾ created ﴿فِيهَا رَوَاسِيَ﴾ firm mountains ﴿وَأَنْهَارًا وَمِنْ كُلِّ الثَّمَرَاتِ جَعَلَ فِيهَا زَوْجَيْنِ اثْنَيْنِ﴾ of every kind ﴿يُغْشِي﴾ He covers ﴿اللَّيْلَ﴾ with its darkness ﴿النَّهَارَ إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ﴾ which has been mentioned ﴿لَآيَاتٍ﴾ indications of His Oneness, Exalted is He ﴿لِقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ﴾ in the handiwork of Allah.

celaleyn:4-4.t: ﴿وَفِي الْأَرْضِ قِطَعٌ﴾ different tracts ﴿مُتَجَاوِرَاتٌ﴾ adjoining one another: among them are good soil and salty soil, of little yield and of much; and this is among the proofs of His power, Exalted is He ﴿وَجَنَّاتٌ﴾ gardens ﴿مِنْ أَعْنَابٍ وَزَرْعٌ﴾ in the nominative, conjoined to جَنَّاتٌ, and in the genitive, conjoined to أَعْنَابٍ; and likewise His words ﴿وَنَخِيلٌ صِنْوَانٌ﴾ plural of صِنْو: palms that share one root while their branches spread apart ﴿وَغَيْرُ صِنْوَانٍ﴾ single ﴿تُسْقَى﴾ with tāʾ, i.e. the gardens and what is in them, and with yāʾ [يُسْقَى], i.e. what has been mentioned ﴿بِمَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ وَنُفَضِّلُ﴾ with nūn and with yāʾ ﴿بَعْضَهَا عَلَى بَعْضٍ فِي الْأُكُلِ﴾ with a ḍamma on the kāf and with it vowelless: some sweet, some sour; and this is among the proofs of His power, Exalted is He ﴿إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ﴾ which has been mentioned ﴿لَآيَاتٍ لِقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ﴾ who reflect.

celaleyn:5-5.t: ﴿وَإِنْ تَعْجَبْ﴾ O Muḥammad, at the disbelievers' denial of you ﴿فَعَجَبٌ﴾ worthy of wonder ﴿قَوْلُهُمْ﴾ denying the resurrection: ﴿أَإِذَا كُنَّا تُرَابًا أَإِنَّا لَفِي خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ﴾ because the One able to bring creation and what preceded into being without any precedent is able to bring them back. In the two hamzas in both places there is: full pronunciation (taḥqīq); full pronunciation of the first and softening (tashīl) of the second; and inserting an alif between them in both ways, or omitting it; and in one reading with the interrogative in the first and the declarative in the second, and in another the reverse. ﴿أُولَئِكَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا بِرَبِّهِمْ وَأُولَئِكَ الْأَغْلَالُ فِي أَعْنَاقِهِمْ وَأُولَئِكَ أَصْحَابُ النَّارِ هُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ﴾

celaleyn:6-6.t: The following was revealed concerning their asking, in mockery, for the punishment to be hastened: ﴿وَيَسْتَعْجِلُونَكَ بِالسَّيِّئَةِ﴾ the punishment ﴿قَبْلَ الْحَسَنَةِ﴾ mercy ﴿وَقَدْ خَلَتْ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمُ الْمَثُلَاتُ﴾ plural of الْمَثُلَة, on the pattern of السَّمُرَة, i.e. the punishments of deniers like them; will they not take warning from them? ﴿وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُو مَغْفِرَةٍ لِلنَّاسِ عَلَى﴾ despite ﴿ظُلْمِهِمْ﴾ otherwise He would not leave a single creature on its surface ﴿وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَشَدِيدُ الْعِقَابِ﴾ for whoever disobeys Him.

celaleyn:7-7.t: ﴿وَيَقُولُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَوْلَا﴾ why not ﴿أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْهِ﴾ upon Muḥammad ﴿آيَةٌ مِنْ رَبِّهِ﴾ like the staff, the hand and the she-camel. Allah the Exalted said: ﴿إِنَّمَا أَنْتَ مُنْذِرٌ﴾ one who warns the disbelievers; it is not up to you to bring signs ﴿وَلِكُلِّ قَوْمٍ هَادٍ﴾ a prophet who calls them to their Lord with the signs He gives him, not with what they propose.

celaleyn:8-8.t: ﴿اللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تَحْمِلُ كُلُّ أُنْثَى﴾ whether male or female, one or several, and so on ﴿وَمَا تَغِيضُ﴾ falls short ﴿الْأَرْحَامُ﴾ of the term of pregnancy ﴿وَمَا تَزْدَادُ﴾ of it ﴿وَكُلُّ شَيْءٍ عِنْدَهُ بِمِقْدَارٍ﴾ by a single measure which it does not exceed.

celaleyn:9-9.t: ﴿عَالِمُ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ﴾ what is hidden and what is witnessed ﴿الْكَبِيرُ﴾ the Great ﴿الْمُتَعَالِي﴾ above His creation through His dominance; with yāʾ and without it [الْمُتَعَالِ].

celaleyn:10-10.t: ﴿سَوَاءٌ مِنْكُمْ﴾ in His knowledge, Exalted is He ﴿مَنْ أَسَرَّ الْقَوْلَ وَمَنْ جَهَرَ بِهِ وَمَنْ هُوَ مُسْتَخْفٍ﴾ concealed ﴿بِاللَّيْلِ﴾ by its darkness ﴿وَسَارِبٌ﴾ visible as he goes along his sarb, i.e. his way ﴿بِالنَّهَارِ﴾

celaleyn:11-11.t: ﴿لَهُ﴾ for the human being ﴿مُعَقِّبَاتٌ﴾ angels who follow him in succession ﴿مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ﴾ in front of him ﴿وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِ﴾ behind him ﴿يَحْفَظُونَهُ مِنْ أَمْرِ اللَّهِ﴾ i.e. by His command, from the jinn and others ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُغَيِّرُ مَا بِقَوْمٍ﴾ He does not strip them of His favour ﴿حَتَّى يُغَيِّرُوا مَا بِأَنْفُسِهِمْ﴾ of their good state, through disobedience ﴿وَإِذَا أَرَادَ اللَّهُ بِقَوْمٍ سُوءًا﴾ punishment ﴿فَلَا مَرَدَّ لَهُ﴾ from the angels who follow in succession or anyone else ﴿وَمَا لَهُمْ﴾ for those for whom Allah wills evil ﴿مِنْ دُونِهِ﴾ i.e. other than Allah ﴿مِنْ﴾ redundant (zāʾida) ﴿وَالٍ﴾ to keep it from them.

celaleyn:12-12.t: ﴿هُوَ الَّذِي يُرِيكُمُ الْبَرْقَ خَوْفًا﴾ for travellers, of thunderbolts ﴿وَطَمَعًا﴾ for the resident, in rain ﴿وَيُنْشِئُ﴾ He creates ﴿السَّحَابَ الثِّقَالَ﴾ with rain.

celaleyn:13-13.t: ﴿وَيُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ﴾ it is an angel in charge of the clouds, driving them, while being engaged ﴿بِحَمْدِهِ﴾ i.e. saying "Glory be to Allah and with His praise" ﴿وَ﴾ glorify ﴿الْمَلَائِكَةُ مِنْ خِيفَتِهِ﴾ i.e. of Allah ﴿وَيُرْسِلُ الصَّوَاعِقَ﴾ which are a fire that comes out of the clouds ﴿فَيُصِيبُ بِهَا مَنْ يَشَاءُ﴾ and it burns him. It was revealed concerning a man to whom the Prophet ﷺ sent someone to invite him, and he said, "Who is the Messenger of Allah, and what is Allah? Is He of gold, or of silver, or of copper?" Then a thunderbolt struck him and carried off the top of his skull. ﴿وَهُمْ﴾ i.e. the disbelievers ﴿يُجَادِلُونَ﴾ dispute with the Prophet ﷺ ﴿فِي اللَّهِ وَهُوَ شَدِيدُ الْمِحَالِ﴾ strength, or seizing.

celaleyn:14-14.t: ﴿لَهُ﴾ Exalted is He ﴿دَعْوَةُ الْحَقِّ﴾ i.e. its word, which is "There is no god but Allah" ﴿وَالَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ﴾ with yāʾ and with tāʾ; they worship ﴿مِنْ دُونِهِ﴾ i.e. other than Him, and they are the idols ﴿لَا يَسْتَجِيبُونَ لَهُمْ بِشَيْءٍ﴾ of what they ask for ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a response ﴿كَبَاسِطٍ﴾ i.e. like the response (given) to one who stretches out ﴿كَفَّيْهِ إِلَى الْمَاءِ﴾ at the edge of a well, calling it ﴿لِيَبْلُغَ فَاهُ﴾ by rising from the well to it ﴿وَمَا هُوَ بِبَالِغِهِ﴾ i.e. his mouth, ever; likewise they will not respond to them ﴿وَمَا دُعَاءُ الْكَافِرِينَ﴾ their worship of idols, or supplication in the literal sense ﴿إِلَّا فِي ضَلَالٍ﴾ loss.

celaleyn:15-15.t: ﴿وَلِلَّهِ يَسْجُدُ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ طَوْعًا﴾ like the believers ﴿وَكَرْهًا﴾ like the hypocrites and those compelled by the sword ﴿وَ﴾ prostrate ﴿ظِلَالُهُمْ بِالْغُدُوِّ﴾ the early mornings ﴿وَالْآصَالِ﴾ the evenings.

celaleyn:16-16.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾ O Muḥammad, to your people ﴿مَنْ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ قُلِ اللَّهُ﴾ if they do not say it, there is no other answer ﴿قُلْ﴾ to them ﴿أَفَاتَّخَذْتُمْ مِنْ دُونِهِ﴾ i.e. other than Him ﴿أَوْلِيَاءَ﴾ idols which you worship ﴿لَا يَمْلِكُونَ لِأَنْفُسِهِمْ نَفْعًا وَلَا ضَرًّا﴾ and abandoned the One who owns them both? A question of rebuke (istifhām tawbīkh). ﴿قُلْ هَلْ يَسْتَوِي الْأَعْمَى وَالْبَصِيرُ﴾ the disbeliever and the believer ﴿أَمْ هَلْ تَسْتَوِي الظُّلُمَاتُ﴾ disbelief ﴿وَالنُّورُ﴾ faith? No. ﴿أَمْ جَعَلُوا لِلَّهِ شُرَكَاءَ خَلَقُوا كَخَلْقِهِ فَتَشَابَهَ الْخَلْقُ﴾ i.e. the creation of the partners with the creation of Allah ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ so that they believed that they deserved worship because of their creating? A question of denial (istifhām inkār), i.e. the matter is not so, and none deserves worship except the Creator. ﴿قُلِ اللَّهُ خَالِقُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ﴾ He has no partner in it, so He has no partner in worship ﴿وَهُوَ الْوَاحِدُ الْقَهَّارُ﴾ over His servants. Then He struck a parable for truth and falsehood, saying:

celaleyn:17-17.t: ﴿أَنْزَلَ﴾ Exalted is He ﴿مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً﴾ rain ﴿فَسَالَتْ أَوْدِيَةٌ بِقَدَرِهَا﴾ according to the measure of their capacity ﴿فَاحْتَمَلَ السَّيْلُ زَبَدًا رَابِيًا﴾ rising above it, namely the filth and the like on its surface ﴿وَمِمَّا تُوقِدُونَ﴾ with tāʾ and with yāʾ [يُوقِدُونَ] ﴿عَلَيْهِ فِي النَّارِ﴾ of the minerals of the earth, such as gold, silver and copper ﴿ابْتِغَاءَ﴾ seeking ﴿حِلْيَةٍ﴾ adornment ﴿أَوْ مَتَاعٍ﴾ something of use, such as vessels, when they are melted ﴿زَبَدٌ مِثْلُهُ﴾ i.e. like the foam of the torrent, namely its dross, which the bellows expel ﴿كَذَلِكَ﴾ which has been mentioned ﴿يَضْرِبُ اللَّهُ الْحَقَّ وَالْبَاطِلَ﴾ i.e. a parable of them ﴿فَأَمَّا الزَّبَدُ﴾ of the torrent and of the minerals heated ﴿فَيَذْهَبُ جُفَاءً﴾ worthless, cast away ﴿وَأَمَّا مَا يَنْفَعُ النَّاسَ﴾ of the water and the minerals ﴿فَيَمْكُثُ﴾ remains ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ for a time. Likewise falsehood fades away and is effaced, even if it rises above the truth at certain times, while the truth is firm and lasting. ﴿كَذَلِكَ﴾ which has been mentioned ﴿يَضْرِبُ﴾ makes clear ﴿اللَّهُ الْأَمْثَالَ﴾

celaleyn:18-18.t: ﴿لِلَّذِينَ اسْتَجَابُوا لِرَبِّهِمْ﴾ answered Him with obedience ﴿الْحُسْنَى﴾ Paradise ﴿وَالَّذِينَ لَمْ يَسْتَجِيبُوا لَهُ﴾ and they are the disbelievers ﴿لَوْ أَنَّ لَهُمْ مَا فِي الْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا وَمِثْلَهُ مَعَهُ لَافْتَدَوْا بِهِ﴾ from the punishment ﴿أُولَئِكَ لَهُمْ سُوءُ الْحِسَابِ﴾ which is being taken to account for everything they did, nothing of it being forgiven ﴿وَمَأْوَاهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ وَبِئْسَ الْمِهَادُ﴾ the bed, it is.

celaleyn:19-19.t: The following was revealed concerning Ḥamza and Abū Jahl: ﴿أَفَمَنْ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّمَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْكَ مِنْ رَبِّكَ الْحَقُّ﴾ and so believed ﴿كَمَنْ هُوَ أَعْمَى﴾ who does not know it and does not believe in it? No. ﴿إِنَّمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ﴾ take admonition ﴿أُولُوا الْأَلْبَابِ﴾ people of understanding.

celaleyn:20-20.t: ﴿الَّذِينَ يُوفُونَ بِعَهْدِ اللَّهِ﴾ taken from them when they were in the world of the seed (ʿālam al-dharr), or every covenant ﴿وَلَا يَنْقُضُونَ الْمِيثَاقَ﴾ by abandoning faith or the obligatory duties.

celaleyn:21-21.t: ﴿وَالَّذِينَ يَصِلُونَ مَا أَمَرَ اللَّهُ بِهِ أَنْ يُوصَلَ﴾ of faith, ties of kinship and other things ﴿وَيَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ﴾ i.e. His threat ﴿وَيَخَافُونَ سُوءَ الْحِسَابِ﴾ its like has preceded.

celaleyn:22-22.t: ﴿وَالَّذِينَ صَبَرُوا﴾ in obedience and affliction, and in refraining from disobedience ﴿ابْتِغَاءَ﴾ seeking ﴿وَجْهِ رَبِّهِمْ﴾ not anything else of the transient things of this world ﴿وَأَقَامُوا الصَّلَوةَ وَأَنْفَقُوا﴾ in obedience ﴿مِمَّا رَزَقْنَاهُمْ سِرًّا وَعَلَانِيَةً وَيَدْرَءُونَ﴾ they repel ﴿بِالْحَسَنَةِ السَّيِّئَةَ﴾ such as ignorance with forbearance and harm with patience ﴿أُولَئِكَ لَهُمْ عُقْبَى الدَّارِ﴾ i.e. the praiseworthy outcome in the abode of the Hereafter, which is:

celaleyn:23-23.t: ﴿جَنَّاتُ عَدْنٍ﴾ residence ﴿يَدْخُلُونَهَا﴾ they ﴿وَمَنْ صَلَحَ﴾ believed ﴿مِنْ آبَائِهِمْ وَأَزْوَاجِهِمْ وَذُرِّيَّاتِهِمْ﴾ even if they did not do as they did, they will be in their ranks as an honour to them ﴿وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ يَدْخُلُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنْ كُلِّ بَابٍ﴾ of the gates of Paradise or of the palaces, when they first enter, to congratulate them, saying:

celaleyn:24-24.t: ﴿سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ this reward ﴿بِمَا صَبَرْتُمْ﴾ because of your patience in this world ﴿فَنِعْمَ عُقْبَى الدَّارِ﴾ your outcome.

celaleyn:25-25.t: ﴿وَالَّذِينَ يَنْقُضُونَ عَهْدَ اللَّهِ مِنْ بَعْدِ مِيثَاقِهِ وَيَقْطَعُونَ مَا أَمَرَ اللَّهُ بِهِ أَنْ يُوصَلَ وَيُفْسِدُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ by disbelief and acts of disobedience ﴿أُولَئِكَ لَهُمُ اللَّعْنَةُ﴾ distance from the mercy of Allah ﴿وَلَهُمْ سُوءُ الدَّارِ﴾ the evil outcome in the abode of the Hereafter, which is Hell.

celaleyn:26-26.t: ﴿اللَّهُ يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ﴾ He makes it ample ﴿لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيَقْدِرُ﴾ He straitens it for whom He wills ﴿وَفَرِحُوا﴾ i.e. the people of Mecca, with an exultant joy ﴿بِالْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا﴾ i.e. in what they obtained in it ﴿وَمَا الْحَيَاةُ الدُّنْيَا فِي﴾ comparison with the life of ﴿الْآخِرَةِ إِلَّا مَتَاعٌ﴾ a small thing that is enjoyed and passes away.

celaleyn:27-27.t: ﴿وَيَقُولُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا﴾ of the people of Mecca ﴿لَوْلَا﴾ why not ﴿أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْهِ﴾ upon Muḥammad ﴿آيَةٌ مِنْ رَبِّهِ﴾ like the staff, the hand and the she-camel ﴿قُلْ﴾ to them ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُضِلُّ مَنْ يَشَاءُ﴾ to lead astray, and signs avail him nothing ﴿وَيَهْدِي﴾ guides ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾ to His religion ﴿مَنْ أَنَابَ﴾ turned back to Him; and (what follows) is a badal (substitute) for مَنْ:

celaleyn:28-28.t: ﴿الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَتَطْمَئِنُّ﴾ find rest ﴿قُلُوبُهُمْ بِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ﴾ i.e. His promise ﴿أَلَا بِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ تَطْمَئِنُّ الْقُلُوبُ﴾ i.e. the hearts of the believers.

celaleyn:29-29.t: ﴿الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is ﴿طُوبَى﴾ a maṣdar (verbal noun) from al-ṭīb (goodness), or a tree in Paradise in whose shade a rider travels a hundred years without crossing it ﴿لَهُمْ وَحُسْنُ مَآبٍ﴾ place of return.

celaleyn:30-30.t: ﴿كَذَلِكَ﴾ just as We sent the prophets before you ﴿أَرْسَلْنَاكَ فِي أُمَّةٍ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِنْ قَبْلِهَا أُمَمٌ لِتَتْلُوَ﴾ recite ﴿عَلَيْهِمُ الَّذِي أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ﴾ i.e. the Quran ﴿وَهُمْ يَكْفُرُونَ بِالرَّحْمَنِ﴾ in that, when they were commanded to prostrate to Him, they said, "And what is al-Raḥmān?" ﴿قُلْ﴾ to them, O Muḥammad ﴿هُوَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَإِلَيْهِ مَتَابِ﴾ The following was revealed when they said to him: "If you are a prophet, move the mountains of Mecca away from us, make rivers and springs for us in it so that we may plant and sow, and raise up our dead forefathers for us to tell us that you are a prophet."

celaleyn:31-31.t: ﴿وَلَوْ أَنَّ قُرْآنًا سُيِّرَتْ بِهِ الْجِبَالُ﴾ moved from their places ﴿أَوْ قُطِّعَتْ﴾ split ﴿بِهِ الْأَرْضُ أَوْ كُلِّمَ بِهِ الْمَوْتَى﴾ by being brought to life, they would not believe ﴿بَلْ لِلَّهِ الْأَمْرُ جَمِيعًا﴾ not to anyone else; so none believes except the one whose faith He wills, and no one else, even if they were given what they proposed. The following was revealed when the Companions wished that what they had proposed be brought forth, hoping for their faith: ﴿أَفَلَمْ يَيْأَسِ﴾ know ﴿الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا أَنْ﴾ lightened (mukhaffafa), i.e. أَنَّهُ ﴿لَوْ يَشَاءُ اللَّهُ لَهَدَى النَّاسَ جَمِيعًا﴾ to faith without any sign ﴿وَلَا يَزَالُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا﴾ of the people of Mecca ﴿تُصِيبُهُمْ بِمَا صَنَعُوا﴾ because of what they did, i.e. their disbelief ﴿قَارِعَةٌ﴾ a calamity that strikes them with kinds of affliction: killing, captivity, war and drought ﴿أَوْ تَحُلُّ﴾ O Muḥammad, with your army ﴿قَرِيبًا مِنْ دَارِهِمْ﴾ Mecca ﴿حَتَّى يَأْتِيَ وَعْدُ اللَّهِ﴾ of victory over them ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ﴾ And he did halt at al-Ḥudaybiya, until the conquest of Mecca came.

celaleyn:32-32.t: ﴿وَلَقَدِ اسْتُهْزِئَ بِرُسُلٍ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ﴾ as you have been mocked; this is a consolation for the Prophet ﷺ ﴿فَأَمْلَيْتُ﴾ I granted respite ﴿لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا ثُمَّ أَخَذْتُهُمْ﴾ with punishment ﴿فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عِقَابِ﴾ i.e. it fell where it should; and so I will do with those who mock you.

celaleyn:33-33.t: ﴿أَفَمَنْ هُوَ قَائِمٌ﴾ watching ﴿عَلَى كُلِّ نَفْسٍ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ﴾ did of good and evil, and He is Allah, like one who is not so, of the idols? No. This is indicated by ﴿وَجَعَلُوا لِلَّهِ شُرَكَاءَ قُلْ سَمُّوهُمْ﴾ to Him: who are they? ﴿أَمْ﴾ rather ﴿تُنَبِّئُونَهُ﴾ do you inform Allah ﴿بِمَا﴾ i.e. of a partner ﴿لَا يَعْلَمُ فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ A question of denial (istifhām inkār), i.e. He has no partner, for if there were one He would know of it; Exalted is He above that. ﴿أَمْ﴾ rather do you call them partners ﴿بِظَاهِرٍ مِنَ الْقَوْلِ﴾ with a false supposition that has no reality within ﴿بَلْ زُيِّنَ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مَكْرُهُمْ﴾ their disbelief ﴿وَصُدُّوا عَنِ السَّبِيلِ﴾ the path of guidance ﴿وَمَنْ يُضْلِلِ اللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِنْ هَادٍ﴾

celaleyn:34-34.t: ﴿لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ فِي الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا﴾ by killing and captivity ﴿وَلَعَذَابُ الْآخِرَةِ أَشَقُّ﴾ more severe than it ﴿وَمَا لَهُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾ i.e. His punishment ﴿مِنْ وَاقٍ﴾ protector.

celaleyn:35-35.t: ﴿مَثَلُ﴾ the description of ﴿الْجَنَّةِ الَّتِي وُعِدَ الْمُتَّقُونَ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, i.e. "is among what We relate to you" ﴿تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ أُكُلُهَا﴾ what is eaten in it ﴿دَائِمٌ﴾ does not cease ﴿وَظِلُّهَا﴾ is perpetual, no sun displaces it, since there is no sun in it ﴿تِلْكَ﴾ i.e. Paradise ﴿عُقْبَى﴾ the outcome of ﴿الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا﴾ associating partners ﴿وَعُقْبَى الْكَافِرِينَ النَّارُ﴾

celaleyn:36-36.t: ﴿وَالَّذِينَ آتَيْنَاهُمُ الْكِتَابَ﴾ such as ʿAbd Allāh ibn Salām and others of the believing Jews ﴿يَفْرَحُونَ بِمَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْكَ﴾ because it agrees with what they have ﴿وَمِنَ الْأَحْزَابِ﴾ those of the polytheists and the Jews who formed factions against you in enmity ﴿مَنْ يُنْكِرُ بَعْضَهُ﴾ such as the mention of al-Raḥmān, and what is other than the stories ﴿قُلْ إِنَّمَا أُمِرْتُ﴾ in what has been sent down to me ﴿أَنْ﴾ i.e. بِأَنْ ﴿أَعْبُدَ اللَّهَ وَلَا أُشْرِكَ بِهِ إِلَيْهِ أَدْعُو وَإِلَيْهِ مَآبِ﴾ my return.

celaleyn:37-37.t: ﴿وَكَذَلِكَ﴾ sending down ﴿أَنْزَلْنَاهُ﴾ i.e. the Quran ﴿حُكْمًا عَرَبِيًّا﴾ in the language of the Arabs, by which you judge between people ﴿وَلَئِنِ اتَّبَعْتَ أَهْوَاءَهُمْ﴾ i.e. of the disbelievers, in what they call you to of their creed, hypothetically ﴿بَعْدَ مَا جَاءَكَ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ﴾ of the Oneness (tawḥīd) ﴿مَا لَكَ مِنَ اللَّهِ مِنْ﴾ redundant (zāʾida) ﴿وَلِيٍّ﴾ helper ﴿وَلَا وَاقٍ﴾ protector from His punishment. The following was revealed when they reproached him for having many wives:

celaleyn:38-38.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلًا مِنْ قَبْلِكَ وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُمْ أَزْوَاجًا وَذُرِّيَّةً﴾ children, and you are like them ﴿وَمَا كَانَ لِرَسُولٍ﴾ of them ﴿أَنْ يَأْتِيَ بِآيَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ﴾ because they are servants under a Lord ﴿لِكُلِّ أَجَلٍ﴾ term ﴿كِتَابٌ﴾ in which its fixing is written.

celaleyn:39-39.t: ﴿يَمْحُو اللَّهُ﴾ from it ﴿مَا يَشَاءُ وَيُثْبِتُ﴾ with the light and with the doubled form; in it, whatever He wills of rulings and other things ﴿وَعِنْدَهُ أُمُّ الْكِتَابِ﴾ its source, of which nothing changes, and it is what He wrote in pre-eternity.

celaleyn:40-40.t: ﴿وَإِمَّا﴾ in it the nūn of the conditional إِنْ is assimilated into the added (redundant) مَا ﴿نُرِيَنَّكَ بَعْضَ الَّذِي نَعِدُهُمْ﴾ of punishment, in your lifetime; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, i.e. "then so be it" ﴿أَوْ نَتَوَفَّيَنَّكَ﴾ before punishing them ﴿فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيْكَ الْبَلَاغُ﴾ nothing is upon you except conveying ﴿وَعَلَيْنَا الْحِسَابُ﴾ when they come to Us, and We shall recompense them.

celaleyn:41-41.t: ﴿أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا﴾ i.e. the people of Mecca ﴿أَنَّا نَأْتِي الْأَرْضَ﴾ We aim at their land ﴿نَنْقُصُهَا مِنْ أَطْرَافِهَا﴾ through the conquest granted to the Prophet ﷺ ﴿وَاللَّهُ يَحْكُمُ﴾ in His creation as He wills ﴿لَا مُعَقِّبَ﴾ none can turn back ﴿لِحُكْمِهِ وَهُوَ سَرِيعُ الْحِسَابِ﴾

celaleyn:42-42.t: ﴿وَقَدْ مَكَرَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ﴾ of the nations, against their prophets, as they plotted against you ﴿فَلِلَّهِ الْمَكْرُ جَمِيعًا﴾ and their plotting is not like His plotting, because He, Exalted is He, ﴿يَعْلَمُ مَا تَكْسِبُ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ﴾ and prepares its recompense for it; and this is the plotting, because He brings it upon them from where they do not perceive ﴿وَسَيَعْلَمُ الْكَافِرُ﴾ what is meant by it is the genus; and in one reading [الْكُفَّارُ] ﴿لِمَنْ عُقْبَى الدَّارِ﴾ i.e. the praiseworthy outcome in the abode of the Hereafter: is it theirs, or the Prophet's ﷺ and his Companions'?

celaleyn:43-43.t: ﴿وَيَقُولُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا﴾ to you ﴿لَسْتَ مُرْسَلًا قُلْ﴾ to them ﴿كَفَى بِاللَّهِ شَهِيدًا بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكُمْ﴾ to my truthfulness ﴿وَمَنْ عِنْدَهُ عِلْمُ الْكِتَابِ﴾ of the believers among the Jews and the Christians.

daas-irab:22-23.t: ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ conjoined to the earlier الذين. ﴿صَبَرُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. ﴿ابْتِغاءَ﴾ mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). ﴿وَجْهِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿رَبِّهِمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَأَقامُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿الصَّلاةَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَأَنْفَقُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِمَّا﴾ mā is a relative; [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to (mutaʿalliq) أنفقوا. ﴿رَزَقْناهُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿سِرًّا﴾ accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ). ﴿وَعَلانِيَةً﴾ conjoined to سرا. ﴿وَيَدْرَؤُنَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِالْحَسَنَةِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يدرؤون. ﴿السَّيِّئَةَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾ a demonstrative in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); the kāf is for address. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿عُقْبَى﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif owing to impossibility; the clause is the khabar of أولئك. ﴿الدَّارِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿جَنَّاتُ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿عَدْنٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿يَدْخُلُونَها﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the khabar. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and man is a relative noun conjoined to أولئك. ﴿صَلَحَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿مِنْ آبائِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of صلح; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَأَزْواجِهِمْ وَذُرِّيَّاتِهِمْ﴾ conjoined to آبائهم. ﴿وَالْمَلائِكَةُ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); الملائكة is mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَدْخُلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar, and the clause of the mubtadaʾ and khabar is in the position of accusative as ḥāl. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يدخلون. ﴿مِنْ كُلِّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يدخلون. ﴿بابٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi.

daas-irab:24-26.t: ﴿سَلامٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate); the clause is the speech (maqūl al-qawl) of an omitted verb of saying. ﴿بِما﴾ mā is a relative; [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to سلام. ﴿صَبَرْتُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿فَنِعْمَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and نعم is a past verb for expressing praise. ﴿عُقْبَى﴾ fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif owing to impossibility; the clause is conjoined. ﴿الدَّارِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, mubtadaʾ; the clause is resumptive. ﴿يَنْقُضُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿عَهْدَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ينقضون. ﴿مِيثاقِهِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَيَقْطَعُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿ما﴾ a relative, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أَمَرَ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿بِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أمر. ﴿أَنْ يُوصَلَ﴾ an is the particle of the subjunctive (nāṣiba), and a passive imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), with a latent (mustatir) nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is to be interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of genitive as a badal (substitute) of the hāʾ in به. ﴿وَيُفْسِدُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يفسدون. ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾ a demonstrative in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; the kāf is for address; the clause is the khabar of الذين. ﴿لَهُمُ اللَّعْنَةُ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ, and a preposition and its genitive noun attached to a fronted khabar; the clause is the khabar of أولئك. ﴿وَلَهُمْ سُوءُ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ, and a preposition and its genitive noun attached to a fronted khabar; the clause is conjoined. ﴿الدَّارِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Divine Name, mubtadaʾ; the clause is resumptive. ﴿يَبْسُطُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar. ﴿الرِّزْقَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لِمَنْ﴾ a relative; [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to يبسط. ﴿يَشاءُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَيَقْدِرُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, conjoined to يبسط. ﴿وَفَرِحُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿بِالْحَياةِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to فرحوا. ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of الحياة. ﴿وَمَا﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and mā is negative. ﴿الْحَياةُ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾ an adjective. ﴿فِي الْآخِرَةِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿مَتاعٌ﴾ khabar; the clause is a ḥāl.

daas-irab:27-28.t: ﴿وَيَقُولُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and an imperfect verb. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun in the position of nominative as fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿لَوْلا﴾ a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ). ﴿أُنْزِلَ﴾ a passive past verb. ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أنزل. ﴿آيَةٌ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿مِنْ رَبِّهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa); the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is in the position of accusative as the speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ inna, and the Divine Name is its noun; the clause is the speech. ﴿يُضِلُّ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a relative in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of inna. ﴿يَشاءُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَيَهْدِي﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ owing to heaviness, and its fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يهدي. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a relative in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. «[Translator's note: the source analyses this word twice in succession; both are translated as written.]» ﴿أَنابَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila, with no grammatical position. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative, badal (substitute) of من in من أناب. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَتَطْمَئِنُّ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative. ﴿قُلُوبُهُمْ﴾ fāʿil; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بِذِكْرِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تطمئن. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَلا﴾ a particle of alerting and opening (tanbīh wa-istiftāḥ). ﴿بِذِكْرِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تطمئن. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿تَطْمَئِنُّ الْقُلُوبُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:29-30.t: ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَعَمِلُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿الصَّالِحاتِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) with the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿طُوبى﴾ mubtadaʾ, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif owing to impossibility. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate); the clause طوبى etc. is the khabar of الذين. ﴿وَحُسْنُ﴾ conjoined to طوبى. ﴿مَآبٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾ the kāf is a preposition and ذا a demonstrative; [they are] attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَرْسَلْناكَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فِي أُمَّةٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أرسلناك. ﴿قَدْ﴾ a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq). ﴿خَلَتْ﴾ a past verb, and the tāʾ is for the feminine; the clause is an adjective of أمة. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to خلت. ﴿أُمَمٌ﴾ fāʿil, nominative. ﴿لِتَتْلُوَا﴾ the lām is causal (taʿlīl), and تتلو is an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied an after the lām of causation, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the lām and what follows it are attached to أرسلنا. ﴿عَلَيْهِمُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تتلو. ﴿الَّذِي﴾ a relative in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أَوْحَيْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of the relative, with no grammatical position. ﴿إِلَيْكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أوحينا. ﴿وَهُمْ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and [هم is] mubtadaʾ; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿يَكْفُرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar. ﴿بِالرَّحْمنِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يكفرون. ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿هُوَ رَبِّي﴾ mubtadaʾ and khabar; the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿لا﴾ the lā of generic negation. ﴿إِلهَ﴾ its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa in the position of accusative; the khabar is omitted. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿هُوَ﴾ a badal (substitute) of the pronoun concealed in the omitted khabar; the clause is in the position of nominative as a second khabar. ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to توكلت. ﴿تَوَكَّلْتُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَإِلَيْهِ مَتابِ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to a fronted khabar; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:31-31.t: ﴿وَلَوْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and law is a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿أَنَّ قُرْآناً﴾ anna and its noun; the clause is resumptive. ﴿سُيِّرَتْ﴾ a passive past verb, and the tāʾ is for the feminine. ﴿بِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) سيرت. ﴿الْجِبالُ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿أَوْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿قُطِّعَتْ بِهِ الْأَرْضُ﴾ a passive past verb, and the tāʾ is for the feminine; به is attached to قطعت, and الأرض is nāʾib fāʿil. ﴿أَوْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿كُلِّمَ بِهِ الْمَوْتى﴾ a passive past verb and its nāʾib fāʿil, and [به, a preposition and its genitive noun,] attached to كلم; the two clauses are conjoined, and the apodosis (jawāb) of law is omitted. ﴿بَلْ﴾ a particle of digression (iḍrāb). ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name, genitive (majrūr) by the lām; [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to the fronted khabar. ﴿الْأَمْرُ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is resumptive. ﴿جَمِيعاً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿أَفَلَمْ﴾ the hamza is interrogative, the fāʾ is resumptive, and lam is a particle of negation, jussive and conversion [to the past]. ﴿يَيْأَسِ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and given a kasra because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; the clause is resumptive. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative, fāʿil (agent). ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿أَنَّ﴾ lightened from the heavy anna, and its noun is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn). ﴿لَوْ﴾ a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿يَشاءُ اللَّهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the Divine Name is its fāʿil; the clause is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿لَهَدَى النَّاسَ﴾ the lām occurs in the apodosis of the condition, and a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), its fāʿil being latent (mustatir); the two clauses of the condition are the khabar of أن. ﴿جَمِيعاً﴾ ḥāl. ﴿وَلا يَزالُ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb; the clause is resumptive. «[Translator's note: so in the source; يزال is an imperfect form.]» ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative, the noun of لا يزال. ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿تُصِيبُهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the khabar of لا يزال. ﴿بِما﴾ a relative; [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to تصيبهم. ﴿صَنَعُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿قارِعَةٌ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿أَوْ تَحُلُّ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿قَرِيباً﴾ an adverb of place, accusative (manṣūb). ﴿مِنْ دارِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to قريبا; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿حَتَّى﴾ a particle of limit and of the genitive. ﴿يَأْتِيَ وَعْدُ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied an after حتى, and its fāʿil. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi; حتى and what follows it, as an interpreted maṣdar, are attached to تحل. «[Translator's note: the source vocalises the word here as اللَّهُ though it parses it as genitive (اللَّهِ).]» ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ inna and its noun; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لا يُخْلِفُ﴾ lā is negative, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar. ﴿الْمِيعادَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi.

daas-irab:32-33.t: ﴿وَلَقَدِ﴾ the wāw is a particle of oath, the lām occurs in the response (jawāb) of an oath, and qad is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq); the oath clause is resumptive. ﴿اسْتُهْزِئَ﴾ a passive past verb. ﴿بِرُسُلٍ﴾ takes the place of the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause has no grammatical position because it is the response of an oath. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an adjective (ṣifa) of رسل. ﴿فَأَمْلَيْتُ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined. ﴿لِلَّذِينَ﴾ a relative; [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to أمليت. ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿ثُمَّ أَخَذْتُهُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined by ثم. ﴿فَكَيْفَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and كيف is the fronted khabar (predicate) of كان. ﴿كانَ عِقابِ﴾ kāna and its noun; the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَفَمَنْ﴾ the hamza is interrogative, the fāʾ is resumptive, and man is a relative, mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is resumptive. ﴿هُوَ قائِمٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ and khabar; the clause is the khabar. ﴿عَلى كُلِّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to قائم. ﴿نَفْسٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿بِما كَسَبَتْ﴾ mā is a relative; [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to كسبت. ﴿وَجَعَلُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive or conjoined. ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name, genitive (majrūr) by the lām; [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to جعلوا. ﴿شُرَكاءَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿سَمُّوهُمْ﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi and the mīm marks the plural; the clause is the speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿أَمْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿تُنَبِّئُونَهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil and the hāʾ its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِما﴾ mā is a relative; [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to يتنبؤونه. «[Translator's note: so in the source; the verb in the verse is تنبئونه.]» ﴿لا يَعْلَمُ﴾ lā is negative, and an imperfect verb, nominative, whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is the ṣila. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يعلم. ﴿أَمْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿بِظاهِرٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تنبئونه. ﴿مِنَ الْقَوْلِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ظاهر. ﴿بَلْ﴾ a particle of digression (iḍrāb). ﴿زُيِّنَ﴾ a passive past verb. ﴿لِلَّذِينَ﴾ a relative; [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to زين. ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿مَكْرُهُمْ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَصُدُّوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a passive past verb and its nāʾib fāʿil. ﴿عَنِ السَّبِيلِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to صدوا; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and man is conditional, mubtadaʾ. ﴿يُضْلِلِ اللَّهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the Divine Name is its fāʿil; it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the two clauses of the condition and its apodosis are in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿فَما﴾ the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa), and mā operates like laysa. ﴿لَهُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the fronted khabar. ﴿مِنَ﴾ a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿هادٍ﴾ the noun of mā, genitive in form and nominative in position; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).

daas-irab:34-35.t: ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿عَذابٌ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is resumptive. ﴿فِي الْحَياةِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an adjective (ṣifa) of عذاب. ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾ an adjective, genitive (majrūr) with an implied (muqaddar) kasra on the alif owing to impossibility. ﴿وَلَعَذابُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, the lām is of inception (ibtidāʾ), and عذاب is mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْآخِرَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أَشَقُّ﴾ khabar; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and mā is negative; لهم is attached to an omitted, fronted khabar. ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name, genitive by من; [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿مِنَ﴾ a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿واقٍ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ, genitive in form and nominative in position; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مَثَلُ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْجَنَّةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الَّتِي﴾ a relative, adjective of الجنة. ﴿وُعِدَ الْمُتَّقُونَ﴾ a passive past verb and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative (marfūʿ) with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهارُ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent), and [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to تجري; the clause is the khabar of مثل. ﴿أُكُلُها دائِمٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ and khabar; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَظِلُّها﴾ a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted; the clause is conjoined. ﴿تِلْكَ﴾ a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ; the lām is for distance and the kāf for address. ﴿عُقْبَى﴾ khabar, nominative with an implied ḍamma on the alif owing to impossibility; the clause is resumptive. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿اتَّقَوْا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَعُقْبَى﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; عقبى is mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْكافِرِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿النَّارُ﴾ khabar; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:36-37.t: ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ the wāw is a particle of resumption, and the relative noun is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿آتَيْناهُمُ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿الْكِتابَ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يَفْرَحُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿بِما﴾ a relative; [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to (mutaʿalliq) يفرحون. ﴿أُنْزِلَ﴾ a passive past verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is omitted. ﴿إِلَيْكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أنزل; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَمِنَ الْأَحْزابِ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿مِنَ﴾ a relative, postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿يُنْكِرُ بَعْضَهُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and its accusative mafʿūl bihi; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is the ṣila. ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنَّما﴾ [inna and mā,] the restraining and the restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿أُمِرْتُ﴾ a passive past verb and its nāʾib fāʿil; the clause is the speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿أَنْ﴾ the particle of the subjunctive (nāṣiba). ﴿أَعْبُدَ اللَّهَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), whose fāʿil is latent, and the Divine Name is mafʿūl bihi, accusative; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from أن أعبد is mafʿūl bihi of أمرت. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and lā is negative. ﴿أُشْرِكَ﴾ an imperfect verb conjoined to أعبد and accusative like it; its fāʿil is omitted. ﴿بِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أشرك. ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ادعو. ﴿أَدْعُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the wāw owing to heaviness; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَإِلَيْهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a fronted khabar. ﴿مَآبِ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَكَذلِكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object): "أنزلناه إنزالا كائنا مثل" («We sent it down with a sending down like…»). ﴿أَنْزَلْناهُ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿حُكْماً﴾ ḥāl. ﴿عَرَبِيًّا﴾ an adjective. ﴿وَلَئِنِ﴾ the wāw is a particle of resumption, the lām paves the way for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa lil-qasam), and in is a jussive conditional particle. ﴿اتَّبَعْتَ أَهْواءَهُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the discourse is resumptive, and the clause of the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) is initial, with no grammatical position. ﴿بَعْدَ﴾ an adverb of time. ﴿ما﴾ a relative in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿جاءَكَ﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi; its fāʿil is latent, referring to ما. ﴿مِنَ الْعِلْمِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿ما لَكَ﴾ mā is negative, operating like laysa, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to its fronted khabar. ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name, genitive by من; [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿مِنَ﴾ a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿وَلِيٍّ﴾ its postponed noun, genitive in form and nominative in position. ﴿وَلا واقٍ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and lā is redundant; واق is conjoined to ولي according to the form, and it is nominative like it. The clause has no grammatical position because it is the clause of the response to an oath.

daas-irab:38-40.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, the lām paves the way for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa lil-qasam), and qad is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq). ﴿أَرْسَلْنا رُسُلًا﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive, and the oath clause has no grammatical position. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أرسلنا. ﴿وَجَعَلْنا لَهُمْ أَزْواجاً﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its first mafʿūl bihi; the preposition and its genitive noun take the place of the second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَذُرِّيَّةً﴾ conjoined to أزواجا. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is resumptive and mā is negative. ﴿كانَ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿لِرَسُولٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted, fronted khabar (predicate) of kāna; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنْ يَأْتِيَ﴾ an is the particle of the subjunctive (nāṣiba), and an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb); an and what follows it are to be interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of nominative as the noun of kāna. ﴿بِآيَةٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يأتي. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿بِإِذْنِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لِكُلِّ أَجَلٍ كِتابٌ﴾ كتاب is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), لكل is attached to a fronted khabar, and أجل is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿يَمْحُوا اللَّهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the wāw owing to heaviness, and the Divine Name is fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿ما﴾ a relative, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يَشاءُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَيُثْبِتُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَعِنْدَهُ أُمُّ الْكِتابِ﴾ أم is a postponed mubtadaʾ, عند is an adverb of place attached to the fronted khabar, the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi and الكتاب is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَإِنْ ما﴾ the wāw is resumptive, in is the conditional, and mā is redundant (zāʾida). ﴿نُرِيَنَّكَ﴾ an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis; the kāf is first mafʿūl bihi, and its fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "نحن". ﴿بَعْضَ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الَّذِي﴾ a relative, muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿نَعِدُهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi, its fāʿil being latent; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿أَوْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿نَتَوَفَّيَنَّكَ﴾ an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and the kāf is its mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَإِنَّما﴾ the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa), and إنما is the restraining and the restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿عَلَيْكَ الْبَلاغُ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to a fronted khabar; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿وَعَلَيْنَا الْحِسابُ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ, and a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the fronted khabar; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:41-43.t: ﴿أَوَلَمْ﴾ the hamza is interrogative, the wāw is resumptive, and lam is jussive. ﴿يَرَوْا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنَّا﴾ anna, and nā is its noun; anna and what follows it take the place of the two objects of يروا. ﴿نَأْتِي الْأَرْضَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ owing to heaviness; the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and الأرض is its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿نَنْقُصُها﴾ an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi, its fāʿil being latent. ﴿مِنْ أَطْرافِها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ننقصها; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ the Divine Name, mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is resumptive. ﴿يَحْكُمُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar. ﴿لا مُعَقِّبَ﴾ the lā of generic negation and its noun. ﴿لِحُكْمِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar of lā; the clause is in the position of accusative as ḥāl. ﴿وَهُوَ سَرِيعُ﴾ mubtadaʾ and khabar; the clause is conjoined. ﴿الْحِسابِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and qad is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq). ﴿مَكَرَ﴾ a past verb. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause); the hāʾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَلِلَّهِ الْمَكْرُ﴾ المكر is a postponed mubtadaʾ, and the Divine Name is genitive by the lām; [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to the fronted khabar; the clause is conjoined. ﴿جَمِيعاً﴾ ḥāl. ﴿يَعْلَمُ ما﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is omitted, and the relative mā is its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿تَكْسِبُ كُلُّ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿نَفْسٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَسَيَعْلَمُ الْكُفَّارُ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لِمَنْ عُقْبَى الدَّارِ﴾ the lām is a preposition, and man is an interrogative noun in the position of genitive by the lām; [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to an omitted, fronted khabar. ﴿عُقْبَى﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative with an implied ḍamma on the alif owing to impossibility. ﴿الدَّارِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi of يعلم. ﴿وَيَقُولُ الَّذِينَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and an imperfect verb, and the relative noun is its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿لَسْتَ مُرْسَلًا﴾ laysa is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, the tāʾ is in the position of nominative as its noun, and مرسلا is its khabar; the clause is the speech (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿كَفى﴾ a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied fatḥa on the alif owing to impossibility. ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾ the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition, and the Divine Name is fāʿil, genitive in form and nominative in position. ﴿شَهِيداً﴾ tamyīz (specification). ﴿بَيْنِي﴾ an adverb of place, and the yāʾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَبَيْنَكُمْ﴾ an adverb of place, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi; it is conjoined to what precedes it, and the two adverbs are attached to شهيدا. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and the relative noun is conjoined to the Divine Name. ﴿عِنْدَهُ﴾ an adverb of place attached to an omitted, fronted khabar. ﴿عِلْمُ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْكِتابِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the ṣila of the relative.

daas-irab:1-2.t: ﴿المر﴾ the luminous letters at the opening of surahs have no i'rab. ﴿تِلْكَ﴾ a demonstrative in the position of a nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); the lām is for distance and the kāf for address. ﴿آياتُ﴾ khabar (predicate); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿الْكِتابِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct). ﴿وَالَّذِي﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and mubtadaʾ; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿أُنْزِلَ﴾ a passive past verb (mabnī lil-majhūl); the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِلَيْكَ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) أنزل. ﴿مِنْ رَبِّكَ﴾ the two are attached to أنزل. ﴿الْحَقُّ﴾ the khabar of الذي. ﴿وَلكِنَّ﴾ the wāw introduces a ḥāl (circumstantial clause), and لكنّ is a particle resembling the verb. ﴿أَكْثَرَ﴾ its noun (ism). ﴿النَّاسِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لا يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ لا is negating, and يعلمون is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is the khabar, and the clause لكنّ etc. is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl. [Translator's note: the source writes يعلمون here; the verse has يؤمنون.] ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ. ﴿الَّذِي﴾ khabar; the clause is initial. ﴿رَفَعَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil latent; the clause is the ṣila of the relative. ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) by the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿بِغَيْرِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿عَمَدٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿تَرَوْنَها﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is in the position of a genitive as an adjective (ṣifa) of عمد. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿اسْتَوى﴾ a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied (muqaddara) on the alif owing to impossibility (al-taʿadhdhur), its fāʿil latent. ﴿عَلَى الْعَرْشِ﴾ the two are attached to استوى. ﴿وَسَخَّرَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿الشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ﴾ الشمس is mafʿūl bihi and القمر is conjoined to it. ﴿كُلٌّ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَجْرِي﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the ḍamma implied on the yāʾ owing to heaviness (al-thiqal), its fāʿil latent; the clause is the khabar, and the clause كل etc. is initial. ﴿لِأَجَلٍ﴾ the two are attached to يجري. ﴿مُسَمًّى﴾ an adjective of أجل. ﴿يُدَبِّرُ الْأَمْرَ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent, and الأمر is its mafʿūl; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿يُفَصِّلُ الْآياتِ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent, and الآيات is its mafʿūl, accusative by the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَعَلَّكُمْ﴾ لعلّ and its noun. ﴿بِلِقاءِ﴾ the two are attached to توقنون. ﴿رَبِّكُمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is a causal explanation (taʿlīliyya) with no grammatical position. ﴿تُوقِنُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of لعلّ.

daas-irab:3-3.t: ﴿وَهُوَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); هو is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الَّذِي﴾ a relative noun, khabar (predicate). ﴿مَدَّ الْأَرْضَ﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl (object), its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَجَعَلَ فِيها رَواسِيَ﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl, its fāʿil latent; فيها: the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) جعل. ﴿وَأَنْهاراً﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to رواسي. ﴿وَمِنْ كُلِّ﴾ the two are attached to the جعل after them. ﴿جَعَلَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil latent. ﴿فِيها﴾ the two are attached to جعل. ﴿زَوْجَيْنِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) by the yāʾ because it is a dual; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿اثْنَيْنِ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of زوجين, accusative by the yāʾ. ﴿يُغْشِي﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma implied (muqaddara) on the yāʾ owing to heaviness (al-thiqal), its fāʿil latent. ﴿اللَّيْلَ﴾ first mafʿūl, and ﴿النَّهارَ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi of يغشي; the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿فِي ذلِكَ﴾ ذا is a demonstrative in the position of a genitive; the two are attached to an omitted khabar of إنّ. ﴿لَآياتٍ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and آيات is the noun (ism) of إنّ, accusative by the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لِقَوْمٍ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted adjective of آيات. ﴿يَتَفَكَّرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is an adjective of قوم.

daas-irab:4-5.t: ﴿وَفِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) a khabar (predicate) placed first. ﴿قِطَعٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject) placed after; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿مُتَجاوِراتٌ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿وَجَنَّاتٌ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūfa) to قطع. ﴿مِنْ أَعْنابٍ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted adjective of جنات. ﴿وَزَرْعٌ﴾ conjoined to أعناب. ﴿وَنَخِيلٌ﴾ conjoined to what preceded. ﴿صِنْوانٌ﴾ an adjective of نخيل. ﴿وَغَيْرُ﴾ conjoined to what preceded. ﴿صِنْوانٌ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct). ﴿يُسْقى﴾ an imperfect passive verb (mabnī lil-majhūl); the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun. ﴿بِماءٍ﴾ the two are attached to يسقى. ﴿واحِدٍ﴾ an adjective of ماء; the clause is an adjective of نخيل. ﴿وَنُفَضِّلُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent; the clause is conjoined to what preceded. ﴿بَعْضَها﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَلى بَعْضٍ﴾ the two are attached to نفضل. ﴿فِي الْأُكُلِ﴾ the two are attached to نفضل. ﴿إِنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿فِي ذلِكَ﴾ ذا is a demonstrative in the position of a genitive; the two are attached to a khabar placed first. ﴿لَآياتٍ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and آيات is the noun (ism) of إنّ, accusative (manṣūb) by the kasra; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لِقَوْمٍ﴾ the two are attached to an adjective of آيات. ﴿يَعْقِلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is an adjective of قوم. ﴿وَإِنْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and إن is a conditional particle governing the jussive. ﴿تَعْجَبْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), its fāʿil latent, its implied form being "أنت". ﴿فَعَجَبٌ قَوْلُهُمْ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis; عجب is mubtadaʾ and قولهم is khabar, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is in the position of a jussive because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a jussive condition joined with the fāʾ. ﴿أَإِذا﴾ the hamza is for interrogation, and إذا is an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān) containing the sense of condition. ﴿كُنَّا تُراباً﴾ كان, its noun and its khabar; the clause is in the position of an accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿أَإِنَّا﴾ the hamza is for disapproving interrogation (istifhām inkārī), and إنّ and its noun. ﴿لَفِي خَلْقٍ﴾ the two are attached to the khabar of إنّ, and the shifted lām. ﴿جَدِيدٍ﴾ an adjective of خلق; the clause reinforces the preceding clause. ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾ أولاء is a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on kasra in the position of a nominative as mubtadaʾ; the lām is for distance and the kāf for address. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ the relative noun is khabar. ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause), and the clause أولئك etc. is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿بِرَبِّهِمْ﴾ the two are attached to كفروا, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَأُولئِكَ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْأَغْلالُ﴾ a second mubtadaʾ. ﴿فِي أَعْناقِهِمْ﴾ the two are attached to the khabar; the clause is the khabar of the first mubtadaʾ, and the first clause is conjoined to what preceded. ﴿وَأُولئِكَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and أولئك is mubtadaʾ. ﴿أَصْحابُ﴾ khabar; the clause is conjoined to what preceded. ﴿النَّارِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿هُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿فِيها﴾ the two are attached to خالدون. ﴿خالِدُونَ﴾ khabar, nominative by the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:6-6.t: ﴿وَيَسْتَعْجِلُونَكَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl (object). ﴿بِالسَّيِّئَةِ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) what precedes them. ﴿قَبْلَ﴾ an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān). ﴿الْحَسَنَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct); the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is the wāw of the ḥāl (circumstantial clause), and قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿خَلَتْ﴾ a past verb, and the tāʾ is for the feminine. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِهِمُ﴾ the two are attached to خلت, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الْمَثُلاتُ﴾ fāʿil; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and إنّ and its noun (ism), and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لَذُو﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and ذو is khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ) by the wāw because it is one of the Five Nouns. ﴿مَغْفِرَةٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لِلنَّاسِ﴾ the two are attached to مغفرة. ﴿عَلى ظُلْمِهِمْ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَشَدِيدُ﴾ إنّ, its noun and its khabar, and the shifted lām. ﴿الْعِقابِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa) by the wāw.

daas-irab:7-10.t: ﴿وَيَقُولُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and an imperfect verb. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿لَوْلا﴾ a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ). ﴿أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْهِ آيَةٌ﴾ a passive past verb (mabnī lil-majhūl) and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); عليه: the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) أنزل. ﴿مِنْ رَبِّهِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of آية; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿إِنَّما﴾ [إنّ] made inoperative and [ما] making it inoperative (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿أَنْتَ مُنْذِرٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿وَلِكُلِّ﴾ the two are attached to هاد. ﴿قَوْمٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct). ﴿هادٍ﴾ mubtadaʾ placed after, nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma implied (muqaddara) on the omitted letter; the clause is resumptive. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ; the clause is resumptive. ﴿يَعْلَمُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir); the clause is the khabar. ﴿ما﴾ a relative, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿تَحْمِلُ كُلُّ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿أُنْثى﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَما﴾ a relative noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the preceding ما. ﴿تَغِيضُ الْأَرْحامُ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil. ﴿وَما﴾ conjoined to what preceded. ﴿تَزْدادُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent. ﴿وَكُلُّ﴾ the wāw introduces a ḥāl (circumstantial clause), and mubtadaʾ. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عِنْدَهُ﴾ an adverb of place (ẓarf makān), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بِمِقْدارٍ﴾ the two are attached to the khabar; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿عالِمُ﴾ khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "هو عالم". ﴿الْغَيْبِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَالشَّهادَةِ﴾ conjoined to الغيب. ﴿الْكَبِيرُ الْمُتَعالِ﴾ two khabars. ﴿سَواءٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted adjective. ﴿مَنْ﴾ a relative noun, khabar. ﴿أَسَرَّ الْقَوْلَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil latent, and القول is its mafʿūl; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and مَن is a relative noun conjoined to the preceding مَن. ﴿جَهَرَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil latent; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿بِهِ﴾ the two are attached to جهر. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ a relative noun conjoined to what preceded. ﴿هُوَ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿مُسْتَخْفٍ﴾ khabar, nominative by the ḍamma implied on the omitted yāʾ. ﴿بِاللَّيْلِ﴾ the two are attached to مستخف; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَسارِبٌ﴾ conjoined to مستخف. ﴿بِالنَّهارِ﴾ the two are attached to سارب; السارب is one going on his way.

daas-irab:11-11.t: ﴿لَهُ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) placed first. ﴿مُعَقِّباتٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject) placed after; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿مِنْ بَيْنِ﴾ the two are attached to an adjective (ṣifa) of معقبات. ﴿يَدَيْهِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct), genitive (majrūr) by the yāʾ, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to من بين يديه. ﴿يَحْفَظُونَهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl (object); the clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya). ﴿مِنْ أَمْرِ﴾ the two are attached to يحفظونه. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ إنّ, and the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism); the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿لا يُغَيِّرُ﴾ لا is negating, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ). ﴿ما﴾ a relative, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿بِقَوْمٍ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause); the clause is the khabar of إنّ. ﴿حَتَّى﴾ a particle of limit (ghāya) and of jarr. ﴿يُغَيِّرُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implicit أن after حتى, the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; حتى and what follows it, as an interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun), are attached to يغير. ﴿ما﴾ a relative, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿بِأَنْفُسِهِمْ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ṣila. ﴿وَإِذا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and إذا is an adverb for future time, governing its protasis in the genitive [as muḍāf ilayhi] and made accusative by its apodosis. ﴿أَرادَ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb, and the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil; the clause is a ṣila. [Translator's note: so in the source; by the book's own account of إذا above, this clause is the muḍāf ilayhi of إذا.] ﴿بِقَوْمٍ﴾ the two are attached to أراد; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿سُوْءاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَلا﴾ the fāʾ occurs in the response to إذا, and لا is the lā of generic negation. ﴿مَرَدَّ﴾ its noun. ﴿لَهُ﴾ the two are attached to the khabar; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a condition that does not govern the jussive. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is resumptive and ما is negating. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ the two are attached to a khabar placed first. ﴿مِنْ دُونِهِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنْ﴾ redundant (zāʾida). ﴿والٍ﴾ mubtadaʾ placed after, nominative in position and genitive in form; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:12-13.t: ﴿هُوَ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الَّذِي﴾ a relative noun, khabar (predicate). ﴿يُرِيكُمُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma implied (muqaddara) on the yāʾ owing to heaviness (al-thiqal), its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir); the kāf is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and the mīm is for the plural. ﴿الْبَرْقَ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿خَوْفاً﴾ mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose) or ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَطَمَعاً﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to خوفا. ﴿وَيُنْشِئُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb, nominative, its fāʿil latent. ﴿السَّحابَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿الثِّقالَ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿وَيُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined by the wāw. ﴿بِحَمْدِهِ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl. ﴿وَالْمَلائِكَةُ﴾ conjoined to الرعد. ﴿وَيُرْسِلُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, its fāʿil latent; the clause is conjoined by the wāw. ﴿الصَّواعِقَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَيُصِيبُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative; the clause is conjoined by the fāʾ. ﴿بِها﴾ the two are attached to يصيب. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. [Translator's note: the source prints ﴿مِنْ﴾; the Quranic word is the relative مَنْ.] ﴿يَشاءُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, its fāʿil latent; the clause is the ṣila, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَهُمْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); هم is mubtadaʾ; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿يُجادِلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar. ﴿فِي اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, genitive (majrūr) by في; the two are attached to يجادلون. ﴿وَهُوَ﴾ the wāw introduces a ḥāl and هو is mubtadaʾ. ﴿شَدِيدُ﴾ khabar; the clause is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl. ﴿الْمِحالِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct); المحال means strength.

daas-irab:14-15.t: ﴿لَهُ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) a khabar (predicate) placed first. ﴿دَعْوَةُ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject) placed after. ﴿الْحَقِّ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, mubtadaʾ; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa) to what preceded, with no grammatical position. ﴿يَدْعُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مِنْ دُونِهِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لا يَسْتَجِيبُونَ﴾ لا is negating, and an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ the two are attached to يستجيبون. ﴿بِشَيْءٍ﴾ the two are attached to يستجيبون. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿كَباسِطِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of a maṣdar (verbal noun), its implied form being "إلا استجابة كائنة كاستجابة باسط" (except with a response like the response [to] one who stretches out). ﴿كَفَّيْهِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive by the yāʾ, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِلَى الْماءِ﴾ the two are attached to باسط. ﴿لِيَبْلُغَ﴾ the lām is the causal lām (lām al-taʿlīl), and يبلغ is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implicit أن after the causal lām, its fāʿil latent (mustatir). ﴿فاهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative by the alif because it is one of the Five Nouns, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the interpreted maṣdar after the preposition — the two are attached to باسط. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw introduces a ḥāl, and ما is negating, operating like ليس. ﴿هُوَ﴾ its noun (ism). ﴿بِبالِغِهِ﴾ the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾid) preposition, and بالغه is the khabar of ما, genitive in form and accusative in position; the clause is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw introduces a ḥāl and ما is negating, and ﴿دُعاءُ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْكافِرِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction. ﴿فِي ضَلالٍ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted khabar. ﴿وَلِلَّهِ﴾ the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and the Name of Majesty is genitive by the lām; the two are attached to يسجد. ﴿يَسْجُدُ﴾ an imperfect verb; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿مَنْ﴾ a relative, fāʿil. ﴿فِي السَّماواتِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ṣila. ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined. ﴿طَوْعاً وَكَرْهاً﴾ the first is a ḥāl and the second is conjoined to it. ﴿وَظِلالُهُمْ﴾ conjoined to مَن, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بِالْغُدُوِّ﴾ the two are attached to يسجد. ﴿وَالْآصالِ﴾ conjoined to بالغدو.

daas-irab:16-16.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿مَنْ﴾ an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿رَبُّ﴾ khabar (predicate); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct). ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to السماوات. ﴿قُلْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil latent; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). [Translator's note: قل is an imperative; the source says "past verb" here.] ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "هو"; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb, its fāʿil latent; the clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya). ﴿أَفَاتَّخَذْتُمْ﴾ the hamza is for interrogation, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿مِنْ دُونِهِ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) أفاتخذتم, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; it stands in place of the second object of اتخذ. ﴿أَوْلِياءَ﴾ first mafʿūl (object). ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿يَمْلِكُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿لِأَنْفُسِهِمْ﴾ the two are attached to يملكون, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿نَفْعاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and لا is redundant (zāʾida). ﴿ضَرًّا﴾ conjoined to نفعا. ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb, its fāʿil latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿هَلْ﴾ an interrogative particle. ﴿يَسْتَوِي﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the ḍamma implied (muqaddara) on the alif owing to heaviness (al-thiqal). [Translator's note: "on the alif" is evidently a slip for "on the yāʾ".] ﴿الْأَعْمى﴾ fāʿil, nominative by the ḍamma implied on the alif owing to impossibility (al-taʿadhdhur); the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿وَالْبَصِيرُ﴾ conjoined to الأعمى. ﴿أَمْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿هَلْ﴾ an interrogative particle. ﴿تَسْتَوِي الظُّلُماتُ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿وَالنُّورُ﴾ conjoined to الظلمات. ﴿أَمْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿جَعَلُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾ the two are attached to a second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿شُرَكاءَ﴾ first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿خَلَقُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is an adjective. ﴿كَخَلْقِهِ﴾ the two are attached to خلقوا. ﴿فَتَشابَهَ الْخَلْقُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ the two are attached to تشابه. ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb, its fāʿil latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿اللَّهُ خالِقُ﴾ mubtadaʾ and khabar; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿كُلِّ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَهُوَ الْواحِدُ الْقَهَّارُ﴾ a mubtadaʾ and its two khabars; the clause is resumptive or conjoined.

daas-irab:17-17.t: ﴿أَنْزَلَ مِنَ السَّماءِ ماءً﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), and its mafʿūl (object); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) أنزل; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿فَسالَتْ أَوْدِيَةٌ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿بِقَدَرِها﴾ the two are attached to سالت. ﴿فَاحْتَمَلَ السَّيْلُ زَبَداً﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl; the clause is conjoined. ﴿رابِياً﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of زبدا. ﴿وَمِمَّا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, مِن is a preposition and ما a relative; the two are attached to a khabar (predicate) placed first. ﴿يُوقِدُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ the two are attached to يوقدون; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿فِي النَّارِ﴾ the two are attached to يوقدون. ﴿ابْتِغاءَ﴾ mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). ﴿حِلْيَةٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct). ﴿أَوْ مَتاعٍ﴾ conjoined. ﴿زَبَدٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject) placed after. ﴿مِثْلُهُ﴾ an adjective, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾ ذا is a demonstrative; the lām is for distance and the kāf for address; the two are attached to an omitted adjective of a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿يَضْرِبُ اللَّهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil. ﴿الْحَقَّ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَالْباطِلَ﴾ conjoined to الحق. ﴿فَأَمَّا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and أمّا is a particle of condition and detailing (tafṣīl). ﴿الزَّبَدُ﴾ mubtadaʾ; its clause is conjoined. ﴿فَيَذْهَبُ﴾ the fāʾ occurs in the response to أمّا, and an imperfect verb, its fāʿil omitted. ﴿جُفاءً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿وَأَمَّا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and أمّا is a particle of condition and detailing. ﴿ما﴾ a relative, mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَنْفَعُ النَّاسَ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent, and الناس is its mafʿūl;
